title: Prime Minister's Youth Skill Development Program (PMYSDP)
description: National flagship initiative providing free technical and vocational training to youth aged 18-40. Market-driven courses in IT, high-tech trades, and conventional skills. Aims to bring youth skills to international standards and create a competitive workforce.
address: NAVTTC Headquarters, Islamabad (Multiple training centers across Pakistan)
phone_number: NAVTTC office in major cities, check pmyp.gov.pk for local centers
support: Special quotas for women and differently-abled youth
eligibility: Special quotas for female and differently-abled candidates
No experience required for most courses
application: Visit pmyp.gov.pk or NAVTTC centers. Create profile with CNIC and details. Select courses. Online application form submission. Quarterly batch openings - early registration recommended due to limited seats.

title: Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT)
type: Free IT Training / Welfare Organization Program
description: Flagship free IT training by Saylani Welfare Trust. Provides hands-on, industry-relevant technology education to 75,000+ students. Over 80 specialized courses in web development, app development, graphic design, cybersecurity, and more. Project-based learning with mentoring.
address: Saylani Welfare Trust centers across major cities (Karachi, Lahore, Hyderabad, Islamabad, Faisalabad, etc.)
phone_number: Check saylaniwelfare.com for center numbers, Toll-free helpline available
support: Web/App Development (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, Angular)
eligibility: Open to domestic and international applicants
application: Visit forms.saylaniwelfare.com. Complete online application form. Provide contact information. Enroll in desired course. Training starts based on batch schedule. Year-round admission with rolling intakes.
source_name: Saylani Welfare Trust - Saylani Mass IT Training

title: Technical Education & Vocational Training Authority (TEVTA)
description: Punjab's official TVET authority managing 150+ vocational institutes. Offers short-term to diploma courses (3-24 months) in technical trades and industrial skills. Free training with monthly stipends. Government-recognized certifications.
address: TEVTA Secretariat, 96-H Gulberg-II, Lahore (Multiple institutes across Punjab districts)
eligibility: Special quotas for women and minorities
application: Visit tevta.gop.pk for course listings. Download application form. Submit to nearest GTTI/GVTI with documents. Quarterly admissions. Interview may be conducted. Selection announced on website.
locations: Lahore, Faisalabad, Rawalpindi, Multan, Bahawalpur, Sargodha, Dera Ghazi Khan
source_name: Technical Education & Vocational Training Authority (TEVTA), Punjab

title: National Freelance Training Program (NFTP)
description: Government-backed program by Ministry of IT & Telecommunication and Punjab Information Technology Board. Provides contemporary freelancing training across 20 centers nationwide. Aims to empower 22,000+ individuals for self-sustainable remote income generation.
address: 20 Centers across Pakistan (Digital centers in major cities + academic partner institutions)
phone_number: Available through nftp.pitb.gov.pk, contact partner institutes
application: Visit nftp.pitb.gov.pk/registration. Complete online signup form. Take 30-minute MCQ test (48 hours to complete). Submit documents for verification. Document verification by NFTP team. Enroll in course upon confirmation.
locations: Partner universities (NED Karachi, QUEST Nawabshah, UET Jamshoro)

title: DigiSkills Pakistan (DigiSkills.pk)
description: Largest online training program in Pakistan offering 100% free digital skills courses with government-recognized e-certificates. 5.5 million+ trainings delivered since 2018. Enables freelancing and remote earning. Batch-based enrollment with limited seats.
address: Online Platform / Virtual University of Pakistan coordination
phone_number: Available through digiskills.pk website, Virtual University support
eligibility: Women empowerment focus - learn from home
application: Visit digiskills.pk/Register. Create account with CNIC and email. Select course preference (2 courses per batch). Complete online registration. Watch course videos through Learning Management System (LMS). Complete assignments and assessment. Receive e-certificate upon completion.

title: Pakistan Software Export Board (PSEB) - IT Training Programs
description: Government IT training by Pakistan Software Export Board. Specialized programs in software development, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and project management. Bridges gap between education and industry requirements. Prepares professionals for global IT sector.
address: PSEB Headquarters, 6th Floor New State Life Tower, Blue Area, Islamabad
phone_number: PSEB recruitment email and National Job Portal njp.gov.pk
application: Check PSEB official website or National Job Portal (njp.gov.pk). Submit application with CV and credentials. Application review process. Shortlist and interview. Training enrollment upon selection.

title: Punjab Skills Development Fund (PSDF)
type: Skills Training with Stipends / Government Program
description: Punjab's largest skills development fund providing free, stipend-supported vocational training. Partnerships with 250+ institutes. Demand-driven trades in IT, healthcare, construction, hospitality. Gender-inclusive with special programs for rural women.
address: PSDF Headquarters, 21-A H Block, Dr. Mateen Fatima Road, Gulberg II, Lahore
phone_number: PSDF office in Lahore, check psdf.org.pk for regional contacts
eligibility: Special programs for women (Mein Digital: age 21-40, 16 years education)
Rural areas prioritized for certain programs
application: Visit psdf.org.pk. Browse available courses. Apply online through PSDF portal. Submit required documents. Application review and verification. Admission confirmation with course start date.
locations: Major cities: Lahore, Faisalabad, Multan, Rawalpindi, Bahawalpur

title: Akhuwat Foundation - Interest-Free Loans for Skill Development
type: Microfinance for Vocational Training / Interest-Free Loans
description: World's largest interest-free microfinance institution providing Qarz-e-Hasna loans for skill development and business. 800+ branches across Pakistan. Empowers 6+ million families. Supports vocational training, business startups, education, and economic self-reliance.
address: Akhuwat Foundation Headquarters, Lahore (800+ branches nationwide)
application: Visit nearest Akhuwat branch or apply online. Complete application form with details. Document submission and verification. Home/business visit by field officer. Committee review. Loan approval and disbursement (7-21 days).

title: Sindh Technical Education & Vocational Training Authority (STEVTA)
description: Sindh's official TVET authority managing technical and vocational institutes. Provides training in demand-driven trades for youth employment. Regulated technical institutes across Sindh. Government-recognized certifications and diplomas.
address: STEVTA Headquarters, Karachi (Multiple institutes across Sindh)
phone_number: STEVTA office Karachi, District offices in major cities
application: Visit STEVTA website. Browse vocational programs. Submit application with documents. Registration at nearest institute. Admission process completion. Course enrollment.
source_name: Sindh Technical Education & Vocational Training Authority (STEVTA)

title: Saylani Welfare Trust - Vocational Training Programs
description: Saylani Welfare Trust's vocational training division providing comprehensive free training. Covers nursing, cooking, tailoring, driving, beautician courses. Focus on practical skills for immediate employment. Supports underprivileged individuals.
address: Saylani Welfare Trust centers across Pakistan
eligibility: No formal education requirement for most courses
application: Contact nearest Saylani center. Complete enrollment form. Provide basic information. Register for desired course. Training starts based on batch schedule.

title: Hunarmand Pakistan Program
description: National youth skill development program providing vocational training in various trades. Focus on employment creation and self-reliance. Covers high-demand sectors. Government-backed with certification and placement support.
address: Multiple training centers across Pakistan provinces
eligibility: Minimum education as per course requirement
application: Check provincial labor department website. Browse available programs. Complete application. Submit documents. Admission upon verification.
source_name: Ministry of Overseas Pakistanis & Human Resource Development
